sources.sprites: local sprite when available; otherwise explicit base-form fallback via spriteKey until reviewed Mega art is imported

abilitySemantics.dragonize: Pokémon Showdown ability text/data: Normal-type moves become Dragon-type and receive a 1.2x power boost.
abilitySemantics.mega-sol: Pokémon Champions Showdown fork Pokemon.effectiveWeather(): active Mega Sol holder treats effective weather as sunny day without changing field weather.

sources.crossCheck: PokéBase Champions form blocks are canonical for Champions typing/stats/Ability; Pokémon Database or Serebii Champions per-form physical blocks are cross-checked for explicit height/weight. R3-85 Wave 8 promotes 22 Mega relations across 21 base species (18 newly recruitable plus Absol/Garchomp/Lucario Z branches), including distinct Raichu X/Y forms and a male-only Meowstic gate.

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.description: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

abilities.name: Mega Launcher
abilities.description: Powers up pulse moves.

abilities.name: Adaptability
abilities.description: Increases the Same Type Attack Bonus from *1.5 to *2.

abilities.name: Tough Claws
abilities.description: Powers up moves that make direct contact.

abilities.name: Drought
abilities.description: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.

abilities.name: Bulletproof
abilities.description: Protects the Pokémon from some ball and bomb moves.

abilities.name: Technician
abilities.description: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.

abilities.name: Dragonize
abilities.description: Normal-type moves used by the Pokémon become Dragon-type moves and are powered up.

abilities.name: Mega Sol
abilities.description: The Pokémon uses its moves as though the sunlight were harsh, without changing the field weather for other Pokémon.

abilities.name: Sand Force
abilities.description: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.

abilities.name: Sheer Force
abilities.description: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.

abilities.name: Skill Link
abilities.description: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.

abilities.name: Pure Power
abilities.description: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.

abilities.name: Trace
abilities.description: Ability becomes the same as that of the opponent. Switching this Pokémon out of battle restores its original ability. In a Double Battle, a random opponent’s ability will be copied.

abilities.name: Mold Breaker
abilities.description: The Pokémon's moves are not affected by foe’s abilities during battle

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.

abilities.name: Snow Warning
abilities.description: Snowstorm blows when the Pokémon enters battle. As of X & Y, this lasts 5 turns.

abilities.name: Magic Bounce
abilities.description: Reflects non-attacking moves used on the Pokémon back to the attacking Pokémon

abilities.name: Pixilate
abilities.description: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

abilities.name: Healer
abilities.description: Sometimes cures the status conditions of the Pokémon's allies.

abilities.name: Prankster
abilities.description: Increases the priority of the Pokémon's status moves by 1 stage. However, the Pokémon's status moves no longer work against Dark-type Pokémon.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.description: The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.

abilities.name: Refrigerate
abilities.description: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

abilities.name: Solar Power
abilities.description: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.

abilities.name: Scrappy
abilities.description: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

abilities.name: No Guard
abilities.description: The accuracy of all moves known by this Pokémon and all Pokémon targeting this Pokémon raises to 100%

abilities.name: Strong Jaw
abilities.description: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.

abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.description: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

abilities.name: Sand Stream
abilities.description: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.description: The protections and stat boosts caused by the moves Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen and Safeguard by the opponent are ignored.

abilities.name: Multiscale
abilities.description: Reduces damage afflicted to the Pokémon by 50% if at maximum HP

abilities.name: Huge Power
abilities.description: The Pokémon's Attack stat is doubled while it has this ability.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.description: Damage dealing Ground-type moves have no effect on this Pokémon. Cannot be trapped by Arena Trap ability. Takes no damage from Spikes.

abilities.name: Filter
abilities.description: Reduces damage from super-effective attacks by 25%.

abilities.name: Iron Fist
abilities.description: The power of punching moves is increased by 20%. This stacks with

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat when it takes a  hit that causes its HP to become half or less.

abilities.name: Piercing Drill
abilities.description: Contact moves can pierce protection, dealing one quarter of normal damage while retaining their effects.

abilities.name: Fairy Aura
abilities.description: Powers up Fairy-type moves used by all active Pokémon by 33%.

abilities.name: Shadow Tag
abilities.description: Prevents opposing Pokémon from manually switching, except Ghost types and opposing Shadow Tag holders; escape items and pivot moves still work.

abilities.name: Unseen Fist
abilities.description: Contact moves can pierce protection, dealing one quarter of normal damage while retaining their effects.

abilities.name: Protean
abilities.description: Before the Pokémon uses a move, it becomes a pure Pokémon of that type. This only works once per switch in.

abilities.name: Parental Bond
abilities.description: Single-target damaging moves strike twice; the second hit deals 25% damage and can trigger hit effects independently.

abilities.name: Aerilate
abilities.description: Turns Normal-type moves into Flying-type moves and boosts their power by 20%.

abilities.name: Electric Surge
abilities.description: Creates Electric Terrain for five turns when the Pokémon enters battle or Mega Evolves.

abilities.name: Spicy Spray
abilities.description: Burns an attacker that damages this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Stalwart
abilities.description: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

abilities.name: Innards Out
abilities.description: If this Pokémon is knocked out by an attack, it damages the attacker by the amount of HP it had before the hit.

abilities.name: Sharpness
abilities.description: Powers up slicing moves.

abilities.name: Aura Guard
abilities.description: Halves damage taken from contact moves.
